name: XRP plain open reversal
description: XRP: right after a 15-minute window opens, if the previous window moved more than 1.25 of its usual standard deviations, buy the reversal side (taker, hold to settlement). sol-overreact's rule moved unchanged to XRP, no tuning.
hypothesis: 15-minute returns reverse after big moves on every coin (sign autocorrelation negative every month) and Kalshi's opening quote treats the window as a coin flip. XRP's Kalshi market is thinner than ETH's, and wkend-rev's screen found XRP weekday reversal worth about +1.2c after May. Rule fixed in advance (sol-overreact params, no tuning). Wrong if full CI<=0, <60% months positive, 2x latency loses; the same rule decayed to ~0 on SOL/ETH/BTC since June, so a flat Jun-Aug here would end the idea.
